content: Tool poisoning = injection hidden in tool metadata; indirect injection rides in tool results. Lethal trifecta (Willison, 2025-06-16): private data + untrusted content + external communication in one agent enables exfiltration; MCP mixing of tools from different sources makes it worse; prompt-level guardrails are probabilistic and insufficient; defense is restricting actions after untrusted input (deterministic egress gate, human confirmation). Invariant Labs WhatsApp MCP demo: malicious server steers a trusted server's send tool, rug-pull of descriptions after approval. Claude-specific: Oasis 'Claudy Day' (2026-03) chained hidden injection in claude.ai/new?q= prefill + Files API exfil + open redirect; Rehberger Files API exfil (2025-10).
